review.imagery: 60 gallery entries include 11 dated site photographs. All 21 primary assets, the complete 67-page brochure index, sixty native resources and eleven September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two exact primary repeats, textures, generic lifestyle images and repeated scene crops were excluded. Thirty brochure scenes add whole-tower, residential, office, gym, pool and home interiors. Mixed-use scenes retain their proper office or residential labels. Shared Cove home interiors retain concept scope. The full dusk tower supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All eleven whole original physical sheets 2–12 were visually reviewed on three contacts. Office levels 1–13, level 14 amenities, residential levels 15–30 and the roof remain separately identified. The broker’s one freely displayed studio drawing was viewed at native size and has no numerical area. Three further broker layouts are form-gated and unretrieved. Its position number does not establish a contractual unit. Eleven complete building drawings distinguish office, residential and amenity levels. One attributed broker studio preview is available. No numerical saleable home or office areas are printed on these sheets. Confirm contractual units, office specifications and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: The complete original brochure map 11 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All selected destinations follow its printed schedule. Time rings remain regional schematic context. The current official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinates. Camera-centre numbers were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction pages have dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures and drawings retain Tanami, Mitchell’s, REMapp or Reelly attribution according to the actual host. Public home images, where available, retain their openly observed figure URLs. Source bytes, whole sheets and protected researched records remain intact.
